fix.item: Stale recovery now covers all job modes (archive 120s, other modes 600s).
Atomic claimJob closes the queued-to-running race across concurrent builds.
robots.txt updates are non-fatal, compare-before-write, and only add news.xml when enabled and present.
replaceAtomically uses a single rename; orphan .previous files are cleaned up.
Google News applies the 2-day date window in SQL and advances by examined IDs.
Unicode SEF locs are percent-encoded before FILTER_VALIDATE_URL.
ensureDefaultProfile and installers insert missing provider mappings without re-enabling disabled ones.
Package/component installers no longer force-re-enable disabled providers or plugins on update.
Tools and Dashboard no longer run expensive content-table probes on page load.
Recent/Current URL stats include video, business, and events file types (not only live).

change.item: Runtime .tmp/.htaccess uses IfModule for Apache 2.4 and legacy Deny rules.
Articles Route::link now passes xhtml=false.
Removed unused BuildController::emitJsonAndContinue helper.
Replaced Factory::getLanguage() with Application::getLanguage().
Provider discovery dispatches GenericEvent instead of deprecated triggerEvent.
Packaged media/joomla.asset.json; administrator CSS continues to load via HtmlDocument::addStyleSheet because WebAsset useStyle during Extension::boot does not reach the rendered page.
Progress writes are throttled to about 2 seconds; archive-progress.json is written only for archive builds.
Automatic retention prune runs at most once per day after successful Recent or Google News builds, using chunked deletes.
robots.txt Options field and maintenance controller messages use language keys across all packaged locales.
Articles and Video date windows use sargable OR predicates; archive month probes use index-friendly hasContent LIMIT 1 lookups.
archiveProgress reconciles only when idle and caches status snapshots for about 8 seconds.
Video provider mapping defaults to disabled on first insert.

note.item: Public patch after 1.1.0 quality audits — single 1.1.1 release, no intermediate private builds.
Install and update only through pkg_devartsitemaps.
For production CLI/scheduler builds, set Options sitemap_base_url or Joomla live_site.

addition.item: Packaged language packs for 15 locales: en-GB, el-GR, fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, it-IT, pt-PT, cs-CZ, nl-NL, pl-PL, ru-RU, uk-UA, ja-JP, tr-TR, and zh-CN.
Added SiteUrlResolver for canonical sitemap base URLs (Options sitemap_base_url → Joomla live_site → Uri::root()).
Added XmlGenerator rejection of overlong or invalid loc URLs (length, scheme, control characters, spaces).
Added schema update markers for the 1.0.x and 1.1.0 lines.
Added offline Argos language generation and Google gap-fill scripts for maintainable translations.

change.item: Administrator Dashboard rebuilt with Exts-style hub cards and DevArt red active submenu highlight.
Articles provider loadAlternates() now applies the same public access, category, and publish-window filters as the main query.
Business, Events, and Video absolute URL builders use SiteUrlResolver and strip /administrator/.
Google News 2-day window compares sourceDate in UTC via Factory::getDate().
Package-only GitHub updateserver; removed duplicate component child updateserver.
JED/JAMSS false-positive quieting: ensureNoRunningHeavyBuild rename and non-hex control-character checks.

fix.item: Runtime .tmp directories now receive .htaccess and web.config deny rules via FileManager::ensureDirectory().
Hardened sitemap URL writing so invalid locs are skipped without failing the full build.

note.item: Public minor release after baseline 1.0.1. Intermediate local builds (1.0.2–1.0.14) are not published separately.
Install and update only through pkg_devartsitemaps.
For production CLI/scheduler builds, set Options sitemap_base_url or Joomla live_site.

addition.item: Added root sitemap validation to prevent nested sitemap indexes from being published
Added automatic detection and logging of nested sitemap index files during root sitemap generation
Added direct Main Sitemap and Google News Sitemap links to the administrator dashboard
Added improved Cloudflare cache rule recommendation using URI Path contains "sitemaps"

change.item: Updated the root sitemap to publish only final sitemap files for improved Google Search Console compatibility
Internal provider sitemap indexes remain available internally but are no longer exposed by the root sitemap
Updated robots.txt integration to publish both the Main Sitemap and Google News Sitemap
Improved production stability without changing the existing scheduler, archive or provider architecture

security.item: Added validation to prevent nested sitemap indexes from being published from the root sitemap
Improved XML validation during sitemap publication

note.item: Maintenance release focused on Google Search Console compatibility and production stability
No changes to scheduler, archive generation or sitemap providers
Fully compatible with existing DevArt Sitemaps installations

addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Sitemaps package
Added static XML sitemap generation for maximum performance
Added support for Joomla Articles sitemaps
Added support for DevArt Business sitemaps
Added support for DevArt Events sitemaps
Added support for DevArt Video sitemaps
Added Google News sitemap generation
Added provider-based sitemap architecture
Added provider-specific sitemap indexes
Added archive sitemap generation with monthly splitting
Added scheduled sitemap generation using Joomla Scheduled Tasks
Added build history and activity logging
Added dashboard with sitemap and scheduler status information
Added rebuild, continue, stop and clear operations
Added GitHub-based Joomla update server support

change.item: Built using modern Joomla 6 MVC architecture and PHP 8.3+
Optimized sitemap generation for high-performance and low server load
Separated sitemap generation by provider for improved scalability
Improved archive generation for large websites with monthly XML files
Optimized database queries and build process for very large datasets
Improved compatibility with Cloudflare and CDN environments

security.item: Added ACL support for administrator operations
Added CSRF protection for administrator actions
Added SQL parameter binding for all database operations
Added secure file generation and XML writing
Added validation for sitemap generation tasks and provider operations
Built for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3+ using modern namespaces and production-safe architecture

note.item: Initial public stable release of DevArt Sitemaps for Joomla 6
Built for Joomla 6 only with PHP 8.3+
Optimized for large websites, news portals and enterprise deployments
Always test on a staging environment before production deployment
